name: rtk
post_install_message: RTK installed + initialized globally. `rtk init -g` registers a PreToolUse hook in ~/.claude/settings.json that auto-rewrites Bash commands (git/grep/cat/aws/etc.) to their rtk equivalents. RESTART Claude Code so the hook activates. Then check savings with `rtk gain` (real wrapped executions) — NOT `rtk discover` (transcript intent, may mislead).
description: Rust Token Killer — wraps common commands (git, grep, cat, find, ls, aws, make, terraform, pytest, gh, npm, eslint, playwright, psql, wc) to cut output token cost 60-90%. `rtk init -g` installs its own PreToolUse hook for transparent rewriting.
